cardRule: Purchases on the closing day enter the next cycle. Short months use their last day.
cashBasis: Cash-basis reports. Card purchases become expenses when the statement is paid.
noCards: Add a card to track statements and installments.
projectionNote: Includes opening balances, paid movements and pending items through this date. Unrecorded income and expenses are not forecast.
usedCategory: Category in use: keep or rename it.
localAnalysis: Local analysis • calculations from your records
aiNotice: Free-form questions use OpenAI when configured. Sending shares your question and a monthly financial summary with OpenAI. Account and transaction names are excluded.
aiUnavailable: Conversational AI unavailable. Local analysis remains available.
topQuestion: Where did I spend the most?
compareQuestion: Did I spend more than last month?
planningInvalid: Check the values and required fields.
planningNoData: Not enough data in this period yet.
aiSyncRequired: Sign in and wait for sync before sending questions.
